azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
azkar.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum
azkar.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all.
Say: He is Allah, the One.
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord.
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

azkar.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
azkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him.

azkar.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
azkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
azkar.transliteration: bismillah alladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm.
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah.
Glory and praise be to Allah, as numerous as His creation.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ مُذْهِبَ الْبَأْسِ اشْفِ
azkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the suffering and grant healing.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma salli 'ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad
azkar.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

azkar.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
azkar.transliteration: ya hayyu ya qayyum bi rahmatika astaghith
azkar.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, I seek help through Your mercy.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
azkar.transliteration: subhanallah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illa allah
azkar.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, and there is no deity except Allah.
O Allah, remove the suffering, Lord of mankind.

azkar.text: رَبِّيَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَازَةِ مَشَّاءٍ
azkar.transliteration: rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazati mashsha
azkar.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whisperings and incitements of devils.
O Allah, I ask You for well-being and protection.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
